**Committable anchor from Morph udiff can fall outside the PR diff**

Anchoring committable comments on `validatedData.lineStart/lineEnd` can point outside the PR diff, so `octokit.pulls.createReviewComment` rejects them and `commentManager.service.ts` retries the same invalid range. In `applySingleEdit` and `mapValidationResults`, drop or downgrade candidates whose `newLineStart`/`newLineEnd` is not inside a changed file's diff hunk.



<details>
<summary>Prompt for LLM</summary>

````text
File libs/code-review/pipeline/stages/agent-review.stage.ts, lines 1848-1850:

Committable anchor from Morph udiff can fall outside the PR diff

The new ids route file-level suggestions into ValidateSuggestionsStage for the first time, which makes `github.service.ts` anchor their comments at `validatedData.lineStart/lineEnd` — the raw line numbers of Morph's `applyEdit` udiff — instead of the diff-clamped lines used by every other inline comment (github.service.ts:4689-4694). If that Morph range is not inside a PR diff hunk, `octokit.pulls.createReviewComment` rejects the comment ('line must be part of the diff'), and the retry in commentManager.service.ts:1776-1785 cannot recover because it only rewrites `lineComment.start_line`, which `createReviewComment` overrides from `validatedData` for committable suggestions — so the retry resends the identical invalid range and the finding's inline comment is dropped. Before returning a candidate from `applySingleEdit`/`mapValidationResults` (validate-suggestions.stage.ts), verify that `newLineStart`/`newLineEnd` fall inside one of the changed file's diff hunks and drop or downgrade the candidate otherwise.

Suggested code:

const fileLevelSuggestions = deduped
    .filter((s) => !isPrLevelSuggestion(s))
    .map((s) => (s.id ? s : { ...s, id: crypto.randomUUID() }));

// Downstream, a validated (committable) suggestion is anchored on
// validatedData.lineStart/lineEnd from Morph, so only keep the
// committable flag when that range is inside a diff hunk of the file.
````

</details>

The new ids route file-level suggestions into ValidateSuggestionsStage for the first time, which makes `github.service.ts` anchor their comments at `validatedData.lineStart/lineEnd` — the raw line numbers of Morph's `applyEdit` udiff — instead of the diff-clamped lines used by every other inline comment (github.service.ts:4689-4694). ### [3/3] libs/code-review/pipeline/stages/agent-review.stage.ts:1850
Issue identified during code review:
Ids let ValidateSuggestionsStage override the pipeline's own not-committable guard

Giving every inline suggestion an id makes it a validation candidate even when `filterSuggestions` just marked it `isCommittable: false`, and `mapValidationResults` then re-marks any suggestion whose id is in `validIds` as `isCommittable: true` with `validatedData`. The explicit "posting as normal comment / no Apply button" guard (unsupported language, size threshold, or the failed/errored simplicity check at validate-suggestions.stage.ts:457) is silently overridden — e.g. a transient simplicity-check error is logged as non-committable, yet the comment is still posted with a committable ```suggestion block, letting the user commit code the guard rejected; before this PR `applySingleEdit` returned null for every inline suggestion (no id at line 544), so the override was unreachable. Exclude suggestions already ruled out when building candidates (`prepareValidationCandidates`: `if (suggestion.isCommittable === false) continue;`) or keep the flag in `mapValidationResults` (`if (!suggestion.id || suggestion.isCommittable === false || !validIds.has(suggestion.id)) return suggestion;`).

            this.applySingleEdit(suggestion, filePath, fileData.fileContent),

    );
}
